description: This file defines the ClientOutboundConnectionFactory class, which is responsible for creating and configuring outbound client connections within the Orleans framework. It manages connection initialization, configuration, and dependencies such as message center and connection manager.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnectionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating client outbound connections, managing initialization, and configuring connection parameters within Orleans.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new ClientOutboundConnection instance for a given silo address and connection context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with client-specific options.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that the message center and connection manager are initialized, performing thread-safe lazy initialization.
